name: Triad
description: Three parallel strokes turned as one group, set at any of four bearings — sometimes with the middle one missing.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 12%; height: 56%; margin-left: 44%; margin-top: 22%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; left: 200%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; right: 200%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${round} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.25) { background: transparent; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
